HSE managers · Facilities · SMEs · in French

Statutory inspections register

Periodic inspections required by French regulations, tracked site by site: electrical installations, emergency lighting, fire extinguishers, fire safety systems, lifts, automatic doors, lifting equipment, gas, ventilation. Each built-in frequency cites its official source (INRS brochure ED 828) with the date it was checked; any other check uses a frequency you enter. Due dates, alerts, findings followed until closed with proof, printable register per site, CSV export. A support tool: it does not replace an accredited inspection body.
